title: CentralIdentityReferenceV1
description: Policy-neutral typed opaque references for central MK8DX identity concepts. A reference identifies a record type; it does not establish a claim, alias assignment, or reconciliation result.

playerId.description: Opaque central Player identifier. The opaque component must not encode a name, username, email address, or raw legacy identifier.

userAccountId.description: Opaque central UserAccount identifier, distinct from Player and from any authentication-provider subject.

playerClaimId.description: Opaque identifier for an explicit PlayerClaim relationship record. Its presence alone does not say that the claim is verified or active.

aliasId.description: Opaque identifier for an Alias record. The identifier does not contain or normalize the observed alias text.

playerReference.description: Reference to an already-resolved central Player. It does not reference a UserAccount or assert a claim.

userAccountReference.description: Reference to a central authentication/account identity, not a Player.

playerClaimReference.description: Reference to an explicit relationship record between a UserAccount and a Player, without claim-state semantics.

aliasReference.description: Reference to a provenance-bearing Alias record, not to its observed text.
